paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
heading: Mimalmal Mohpuakna
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

paite: "Israel gam tungtang a hiai paunak azat uh bang chihna ahia, 'Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau hi, chih?'
english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

paite: "Kei ka hin bang in, Israel ah hiai paunak zat nawn chih na nei kei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

paite: Ngai un, hinna tengteng kei a vek ahi, pa hinna kei a ahih bangmah in tapa hinna leng kei a ahi; kha khial peuhmah asi ding.
english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

paite: "Himahleh mi adiktat a, siang leh dik ahih a,
english: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,

paite: mun sangte a ne lou a, Israel inkote milim lam nga sam lou a, numei kizen lou leng naih lou a, kuamah tung a thil hihkhial lou a,
english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,

paite: leibami thil khamna koih pe kik zaw a, kuamah hiamgam a lok lou a, gilkial kiang a nek ding pia a, vuaktang puan silhsak a;
english: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

paite: apung delh ding a leitawisak lou a, asumpung leng la sam lou a, thil gilou hih dia akhut kidek a, mi leh mi kikal a diktak a vai hawmsak a;
english: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,

paite: ka dan bawlte zui a, diktak a hih a, ka vaihawmnate azuihleh, amah midiktat ahi a, ahing ngei ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Himahleh ama'n tapa guktak ching asuan a, sisan suahmi ahih a, hiai bang ahih a,
english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

paite: ahih ding zaw pen ahih louh a, mun sangte a anek zawk a, invengte zi ahihbuah a,
english: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,

paite: genthei leh tasamte asimmoh a, aloh a, akhamna koih apiak louh a, milimte lam nga, thilkihhuai ahih hi.
english: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,

paite: Apung delh a apiak a, apung alakleh, ahing ding hia? Ahing het kei ding; hiai thilkihhuai tengteng ahihta a, asi ngeingei ding, amah sisan moh ama tung ah atu ding ahi.
english: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.

paite: "Huan ngai in, tapa na nei tei taleh, apa thil gilou hihsa tengteng amuh a, lau a,
english: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,

paite: huchibang ahih teitei louh a, mun sang a anek louh a, Israel inkote milim lamte angat louh a, invengte zi ahihnit louh a,
english: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,

paite: kuamah tung a thil ahihkhelh louh a, khamna koih bangmah la lou a, kuamah lok lou a, gilkialte nek ding pe zaw a, savuakte asilhsak a;
english: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

paite: genthei lak a akhut akideksak a, anou leh apung la lou a, ka thupiakte zang a ka dan bawlte zuimi ahihleh, apa thulimlouhna ziak in asi kei ding a, ahing zaw ngei ding hi.
english: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.

paite: Apa bel kheltak a mi nuaisiah a, a-unaupa hiamgamtak a sual a, amite lak a thil hoih lou ahih ziak in, ngai in, athulimlouhna ziak in asi ding ahi.
english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

paite: "Himahleh, bangziak a tapa in apa thulimlouhna thuak lou ding, na chi nak uh? Tapa in dan azuih a thil kizen ahih a, ka dan bawl tengteng azuih a, ahih laileh, ahing ngeingei ding hi.
english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.

paite: Kha khial asi ding; tapa in apa thulimlouhna athuak kei ding a, pa in leng tapa thulimlouhna athuak sam kei ding; midiktat diktatna amah mah tung ah a-om ding, migilou gitlouhna amah mah tung ah a-om ding hi.
english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

paite: "Himahleh, migilou in akhelhna hih tengteng alehngatsan a, ka dan bawlte azuih a, dan zui a thil diktat ahihleh ahing ngei ding a, asi kei ding.
english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

paite: Tatlekna a na hihsa theihsak ahita kei ding; ana hihsa adiktatna ah ahing ding,
english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

paite: Migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei a hia? Alampite alehngatsan a, ahong hin ding chih louh ngal? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

paite: "Himahleh midiktat in adiktatna lampi alehngatsan a, thulimlouhna ahih a, migiloute hih bang zel a thilkihhuaite ahih in ahing dia hia? Athil diktat hihsa bangpeuh leng theihgige ahi nawnta kei ding a, atatlekna hih ah leh akhelhna hih ah, huai mahmah ah asi ding hi.
english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

paite: "Hinapi in, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei hi, na chi sek uh. Israel inkote aw, ngai un; ka hihdan akibang gige kei maw? Na hihdan uh akibang kei gige zaw ahi kei maw?
english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

paite: Midiktat in adiktatnate alehngatsan a, thulimlouhnate ahihleh huai ah asi ding a, thulimlouhna ahih ah asi ding.
english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

paite: Huai lou leng, migilou in akhelhna ahihsate lehngatsan a, dan azuih a, thil diktat ahihleh ahinna ahumbit ding.
english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

paite: Akingaihtuah a, atatlekna a hihsa tengteng alehngatsan ziak in ahing ngei ding, asi kei ding hi.
english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

paite: Hinapi in Israel inkote'n, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei, achi uhi. Aw Israel inkote aw, ka hihdante kibang gige ahi zaw kei maw?
english: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

paite: "Huaiziak in aw Israel inkote aw, michih, noumau hihdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Kihei unla, na tatlekna tengtengte uh lehngatsan un; huchi in thulimlouhna na puksiatna uh ahi kei ding hi.
english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

paite: Na tatlekna tengteng uh, na tatleksate uh paimang vek unla, lungtang thak leh lungsim thak kibawl un! Israel inkote aw, bangziak a si ding na hi ua?
english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

paite: Mi sihna ah kipahna mahmah ka nei kei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; huaiziak in kihei unla, hing un."
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
